content.value: Loop patterns that trigger unroll doubling
in refineTripCounts + depth-3 nesting that
causes CFG node explosion if naive.
Loop A: counter behind gosub (depth 1)
Loop B: dispatch hub, unbounded
Loop C: depth-3 nesting via gosub chains
outer -> middle -> inner, each condition-
bounded but counter modified only in gosub
so static trip count is null at every level.
Loop D: depth-3 nesting, direct goto loops
outer wave loop -> shield drain -> combo
builder, all condition-bounded with counters
modified in nested gosubs.
--- Loop A: counter behind gosub ---
outer: loops on depth, incremented in middle gosub
middle: loops on inner_count, incremented in inner gosub
inner: loops on phase, incremented in deep gosub
wave_loop: exits on wave >= 3, wave incremented in gosub
shield_loop: exits on shield <= 0, shield decremented in gosub
combo_loop: exits on combo >= 5, combo incremented in gosub
